plain_summary: Review potential overlap of selegiline with an SSRI or tricyclic antidepressant.
rule_for_models: Report and cite both supplies when their dates, quantities and directions show overlapping use of selegiline and an SSRI or tricyclic antidepressant (exclude SNRIs). If supplies are within 60 days and unclear directions leave overlap possible, report only a possible finding and ask whether the patient took both medicines at the same time or stopped one before starting the other. A documented course that ended before the other began does not qualify.
cannot_be_seen: Dispensing does not establish actual use, indication or a prescriber’s intent. Treatment and assessments elsewhere may be missing.
ask_the_gp: Could you review the interaction risk from possible overlap between selegiline and this SSRI or tricyclic antidepressant?
